text: Chapter 16: The Royal Dragon Bloodline@Challenge the Crimson Dragon!
According to Kipina, the evil spirit, the Ancient Eternal\nCharcoal seems to be related to Vatran the Crimson Dragon.\nLet's go through Ulme Plains and head to where he lives!
According to Kipina, you must defeat Vatran the Crimson\nDragon to obtain the Ancient Eternal Charcoal. Explore the\nLiekki Redlands, where the dragon dwells, and find him!
The Liekki Redlands is an eerie place surrounded by red\nrocks. Make your way to the deepest area before the extreme\nheat drains your strength!

Vatran the Crimson Dragon awaits you in the deepest area!
He's a massive, fearsome foe, but you have to defeat him to
obtain the Ancient Eternal Charcoal! Fight it with
everything you've got!
